newsitem.title: USA: PictureTel Q1 hurt by videoconf sales.
newsitem.headline: PictureTel Q1 hurt by videoconf sales.

text.p: PictureTel Corp on Wednesday attributed a decline in first quarter earnings to a drop in revenue, specificaly due to a lower than expected volume in desktop videoconferencing unit sales.
PictureTel, however, said it believes the situation will rebound over the remainder of the year.

The firm also pinned the earnings decline on a change in the mix of group systems sales, with customers purchasing the highly popular but lower-priced SwiftSite compact system instead of some of the company's larger group systems.

Earlier, PictureTel reported a 13 percent increase in revenues to $118.2 million for the quarter ended March 29. Hoever, net income for the quarter fell to $3.1 million or $0.09 per share, compared to $7.5 million, or $0.21 per share, for the first quarter of 1996.
PictureTel develops, manufactures and markets a full range of videoconferencing technologies.
